title: Final Energy Levels
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct energy levels E for j = 3, 2, and 1.

title: Final Degeneracies
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct degeneracies d for j = 3, 2, and 1.

title: Use of Angular Momentum
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the relationship between total angular momentum J, orbital angular momentum L, and spin S.

title: Correct Hamiltonian Form
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly express the spin-orbit interaction Hamiltonian H_{s0} in terms of J, L, and S.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the energy expression using the formula E_{s0} = (hbar^2/2) A [j(j+1) - l(l+1) - s(s+1)].

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the energy levels, particularly for j = 2 and j = 1.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms are expressed consistently in terms of hbar and A.
